title: Apply for Taiwan CDC international training

zh-TW.reviewer: 國際合作組中文審核人

summary: Foreign health officials and professionals can apply online for Taiwan CDC international training (FETP exchange, workshops, laboratory, TB-DOTS and dengue control); applications are reviewed within 30 days.
whoCanApply: Public health and laboratory professionals nominated by their agency
Staff of partner institutions under a cooperation arrangement
introMarkdown:
Taiwan CDC welcomes health officials and professionals from partner countries to its international training programs: FETP exchanges, international workshops (including GCTF), laboratory training, TB control and DOTS, and dengue control.

Apply online with the application form and a nomination letter from your agency or the partner representative office. The Division of International Cooperation reviews each application with the hosting division and replies within 30 days.
requiredDocuments: Nomination or endorsement letter from your agency or representative office

steps.title: Choose a program
steps.text: Check the program list and annual schedule on the International training page.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.text: Submit the online form with the nomination letter, CV and passport copy.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: The Division of International Cooperation reviews the application with the hosting division.

steps.title: Notification and arrangements
steps.text: Accepted applicants receive an invitation letter and arrangement details; others are informed of the result.

fee: Training is free of charge; travel and accommodation arrangements depend on the program.
contact: Division of International Cooperation, Taiwan CDC — switchboard +886-2-2395-9825 (office hours); 1922 hotline (from abroad +886-800-001922)

faq.q: Is there a fee for the training?
faq.a: Training is free of charge. Whether travel and accommodation are covered depends on the program and is stated in the invitation letter.

faq.q: Can individuals apply without a nomination?
faq.a: Applications normally need a nomination or endorsement from the applicant’s agency or a partner representative office.

zh-TW.title: 外國衛生人員申請疾管署國際訓練
zh-TW.summary: 外國衛生官員與專業人員可線上申請疾管署國際訓練（FETP 交流、研習營、實驗室、結核病都治、登革熱防治），30 日內回覆審查結果。
whoCanApply: 經所屬機關推薦之公共衛生與實驗室專業人員
合作協定下之夥伴機構人員
zh-TW.introMarkdown:
疾管署歡迎夥伴國家衛生官員與專業人員參加國際訓練：FETP 交流、國際研習營（含 GCTF）、實驗室訓練、結核病防治與都治、登革熱防治。

請線上填寫申請表，並附所屬機關或夥伴國駐臺代表機構推薦函。國際合作組會同主辦單位審查，30 日內回覆。
requiredDocuments: 所屬機關或駐臺代表機構推薦函

steps.title: 選擇訓練計畫
steps.text: 於國際訓練頁查閱計畫與年度時程。

steps.title: 送出申請
steps.text: 線上填寫申請表並上傳推薦函、簡歷與護照影本。

steps.title: 審查
steps.text: 國際合作組會同主辦單位審查。

steps.title: 通知與安排
steps.text: 錄取者收到邀請函與行程安排；未錄取者亦會收到通知。

zh-TW.fee: 訓練免費；交通與住宿依各計畫規定。

faq.a: 訓練免費；交通與住宿是否補助依各計畫規定，並載明於邀請函。

faq.q: 個人可以不經推薦直接申請嗎？
faq.a: 申請通常需所屬機關或夥伴國駐臺代表機構推薦。
